question: What did the 19 September 2017 Maha-Pariksha GR say?
gold_answer: Not in this corpus. It was superseded by the GR of 20-02-2020

gold_grs_detail.title: About updated process of Exams Conduction under Maha-Pariksha.

product.answer: I couldn't find a GR on this in the corpus. The 19 September 2017 Maha-Pariksha GR (GAD-DIT 088/27/2016/DIT (MH)) is cited by the 28-11-2018 GR (088/27/2016-DIR IT(MH)) as the reference Government Resolution regarding use of software applications for conduct of examinations, and the 20-02-2020 GR (मातंस-२०२०/प्र.क्र .११/से-२/३ ९) states that it superseded and overrode the 19 September 2017 GR, replacing it with a new tender and empanelment process for service providers.

raw.answer: I couldn't find a GR on this in the corpus. The corpus does not contain any GR dated 19 September 2017.
